create: createReconciliationHostProvisionReview(repositoryRoot:string): ReconciliationHostProvisionReview; constructor performs readonly actual namespace/binding observation, no mutation. Frozen exact handle own methods start(),confirm(token:string),cancel(); each requires exact this and original actual ALS scope.
start: Once. Returns READY for seed or issuer, or RESULT existing if whole issuer valid. Any replay/foreign/detached method throws RECONCILIATION_PROVISION_REVIEW_INVALID. Actual live scope/clock/identity/B5/namespace drift invalidates review. Constructor errors are closed safe provisioning codes.

ready.namespace_sha256: SHA of exact private namespace witness, no raw paths/records
ready.plan_sha256: SHA256(JCS(all READY fields except this field and confirmation))

artifact.sha256: fixed seed SHA or frozen whole issuer file SHA

ready.effects: array of exact {target,operation,mode}; target logical worktree-host/devai[/reconciliation[/admission.sqlite|/issuer.json]], operation create-directory|publish-seed|sync-precursor|publish-issuer, mode0700|0600. Seed preview lists only missing creates; issuer preview lists sync-precursor and publish-issuer.

result.issuer_sha256: whole file SHA for created/existing; null otherwise
result.stage: seed|issuer|null (null if cancellation before start or existing issuer)
result.owned: readonly array exact {target,dev,ino,birthtime_ns}, all identity fields canonical strings, only identities actually observed as created; empty for ordinary cancellation/existing

confirm: Seed success returns issuer READY; issuer success RESULT created. Wrong token returns RESULT cancelled and terminally closes. Read-only/no-write scope cannot write; underlying real typed operation errors close handle with safe code. Publication/native uncertainty returns RESULT indeterminate, never retries.
cancel: RESULT cancelled with no added effects, then terminal; second cancel or any other reuse refuses. No private artifact bytes/key/MAC/keydigest/physicalpaths/nativecause are returned.
